title: Updates
sub: New resources and changes to the site, newest first.

notes.title: Planner by level, and a My Term dashboard
notes.text: The Planner now has a level dropdown (Foundation, Diploma, Degree, electives, PG) with your courses in two columns, and MA3015 Linear Models with Applications is in the electives. My Term is a dashboard: pick your courses from a searchable list, see the next exam first, and work out what you need in the end term.

notes.title: Cleaner top bar, and Sign in on every page
notes.text: The top bar is a single row with Scam alert one click away and the Grade calculator under More. The Sign in button now appears on every page, so your progress and plans sync wherever you are.

notes.title: Disclaimer on every page
notes.text: Every page now ends with a short note that The Companion is an unofficial student project, so always check the official handbook and grading document for the final word.

notes.title: Common problems on the project pages
notes.text: The MAD I, MAD II, ML Practice, Business Data Management and Deep Learning & GenAI project pages now have a Common problems section: viva slot booking and reattempts, eligibility, deadlines, similarity flags and report rejections, with the answers course staff gave on Discourse this term.

notes.title: Scam alert: new providers and tricks
notes.text: Three providers added to the Scam alert list (SkillOrbit, Wayeva Innovations and Univox Academy), Corizo's entry updated, and a new section on tricks students reported this term: mails from student accounts, "mandatory" courses with payment links, and calls asking for your ID or password.

notes.title: New NPTEL section
notes.text: A new NPTEL page lists the 289 NPTEL courses the BS programme accepts for credit, from the handbook's Tables 2 and 3, with search, a filter for courses open this term, and links to NPTEL and SWAYAM.

notes.title: Degree electives grouped by area
notes.text: The BS electives on the Courses page are now split into Data Science, CS and Programming, Science and Engineering, Humanities and Management, and the mixed areas. Searching a group name, such as management, shows that group.

notes.title: Lectures for Compiler Design and Discrete Mathematics
notes.text: Compiler Design (39 lectures) and Discrete Mathematics (58 lectures, weeks 1 to 12) now list their lectures from the official IITM BS playlists.

notes.title: MLOps lectures, week by week
notes.text: The 55 MLOps lectures are now grouped into weeks 1 to 12 and follow the order of the course videos.

notes.title: Lectures for 13 more electives
notes.text: Industry 4.0, Theory of Computation, Computer Networks, Computer Systems Design, Privacy & Security in Online Social Media, App Development Lab, Advanced Algorithms, Introduction to NLP, Data Science and AI Lab, MLOps, Mathematical Thinking, Linear Statistical Models and Market Research now list their lectures from the official IITM BS playlists.

notes.title: New home page
notes.text: Search every course from the front page, see the next quiz and exam dates, pick up where you left off, and browse courses by level.

notes.title: Lectures for five more electives
notes.text: Operating Systems, Data Visualization Design, Corporate Finance, Financial Forensics and Game Theory now list their lectures week by week, from the official IITM BS playlists.

notes.title: IITM BS GitHub sites and degree-level notes
notes.text: Project and course sites from the IITM BS GitHub (MLP project, DSAI Lab, NumPy and Matplotlib, ML Handbook, Linear Algebra, Python Companion, recommended books, LITEPODS) and full course notes from Rishabh Indoria for seven degree courses.

notes.title: PG Diploma Research Project and MTech Project pages filled in
notes.text: The MTech Project page now explains eligibility, the letters you need and the three stages, with the official project documents. Both pages link the PG Diploma and MTech upgrade path and two Students' Corner guides.

notes.title: Project guides from IITM BS Students' Corner
notes.text: Scope, grading, planning and portfolio guides on all five diploma project pages, from the IITM BS Students' Corner blog.

notes.title: Project bootcamp code and the DL GenAI project site
notes.text: MAD II project session code from Santhana Krishnan S, bootcamp demo code from Nandan Reddy Parnapalli and Shubham, and the DL & GenAI project course site.

notes.title: More MAD resources from Shrikrishna Pandey
notes.text: Revision notes, a mock Quiz 1, practice questions, setup guides for Git and Python, MAD I project plans and the Sep 2026 MAD II project guide.

notes.title: Project pages redesigned
notes.text: Project pages now use the same sidebar as course pages. MAD I, MAD II, MLP, DL GenAI and BDM list every recorded project session, term by term, with progress, Previous and Next. The project brief moved to a Syllabus tab, and each project links back to its main course.

notes.title: Important links reorganised
notes.text: Seven groups by what you need (exams, admin, planning, study material, past papers, careers, community), small cards marked Official or Student-made, and a side list of groups on wide screens.

notes.title: Course resources are now small, even cards
notes.text: Each resource shows its title, one line about it and who made it. Hover for the full description and the site address.

notes.title: Easier to use with a keyboard, a screen reader or a phone
notes.text: Skip to content links, visible focus, keyboard access to every lecture, a two-row menu on phones, larger tap targets and clearer headings.

notes.title: Brighter Light theme and new fonts
notes.text: The Light theme is whiter with darker, sharper text. Headings use Spectral and body text uses IBM Plex Sans.

notes.title: Link previews and a site icon
notes.text: Links shared on WhatsApp or Discourse now show a preview card, and the site has its own icon.

notes.title: Sep 2026 quiz syllabus checked
notes.text: Quiz and end term coverage on every course page matches the Sep 2026 quiz syllabus.

notes.title: Watched progress and a new course sidebar
notes.text: Tick lectures as watched, see how far you are in each week and the whole course, and pick up where you left off. The front page now fits on one screen.

notes.title: Grade calculator
notes.text: Work out your final course score from your quiz, assignment and exam marks, using the formulas in the grading document.

notes.title: Scam alert page
notes.text: How the fake internship offers reaching student emails work, the red flags to look for, and the providers to avoid.

notes.title: Pink theme, a phone course menu and a bigger lecture video
notes.text: A fourth colour theme, a course menu that works on phones, and a larger lecture video with Previous and Next buttons.

notes.title: OPPE tabs on programming courses
notes.text: Practice material and links for the online proctored programming exams, in their own tab on each course.

notes.title: MLT: notes, FAQs, PYQs, practice, TA sessions and modified slides
notes.text: Concept notes, notes by Sherry Thomas and Karthik Thiagarajan, NumPy practice, a Weekly notes tab and modified slides by Piush Das.

notes.title: Java: TA sessions, concept-wise PYQs and OPPE resources
notes.text: A TA sessions tab with week-by-week recordings, PYQs sorted by concept, and OPPE 1 and OPPE 2 material.

notes.title: PDSA: textbook, TA thread, PYQs and a practice site
System Commands: portal, slides, transcripts, cheat sheets, notes and PYQs
MAD resources by Shrikrishna Pandey
notes.text: Guides for MAD I and MAD II and their projects. Project pages can now show resources too.

notes.title: Tools in Data Science course website
notes.text: The course website, in its own tab on the course page.

notes.title: Colour themes
notes.text: Paper, Light and Dark themes, remembered on your device.

notes.title: Contributors page
notes.text: The students, TAs and instructors behind the notes and resources, and how to share yours.

notes.title: Foundation notes and previous term papers by Pratham Bhalla
Course notes from IITM BS Students' Corner and ML Study Hub
notes.text: Notes for most courses, plus Medium notes for nine more courses and the degree level notes page.

notes.title: MAD I resources and DBMS live sessions
New layout: front page, Courses and Important links
notes.text: The site is split into a front page, a Courses page and an Important links page, with dropdown menus and a search that forgives typos.

notes.title: Collapsible course sidebar and a larger lecture video
notes.text: Hide the sidebar to give the video more room. Extra tabs such as OPPE and Course website sit next to Dashboard and Syllabus.

notes.title: Lecture videos for all eight Foundation courses
Important links
notes.text: The student handbook, academic calendar, score checker, resource collections and more, in one place.

notes.title: DBMS and Python OPPE practice, and the MLOps course website
Degree level course pages filled in
notes.text: Syllabus, faculty and lectures for 16 degree level courses.

notes.title: The Companion goes live
notes.text: Every course in the IIT Madras BS in Data Science and Applications, with its syllabus, faculty and week-by-week plan. Always check the official handbook and grading document too.

resource_notes.MauryaHub course videos: Video walkthroughs of past papers, weekly questions and revision, one page for each course.
resource_notes.MauryaHub student notes | Ashish Maurya: Notes, cheatsheets, e-books and solved PYQs shared by students. Each course links to its own subject.
resource_notes.Custodia OPPE practice: Browser-based OPPE practice with testcases and instant grading. Needs Google sign-in. A student-run site, not run by IITM.
resource_notes.MauryaHub student notes | Kailash: A shared study pack for MLF, MLT, MLP, DL GenAI and Java, plus an MLT end term guide.
